name: Polar Slice Generation for Rotating Displays
aliases: Blender Polar Slice Generation for Rotating Volumetric Displays
definition: Generates discrete volumetric data in 3D polar coordinates (r, theta, z) for a rotating volumetric display by rendering orthographic camera views of a boolean-intersected slice through a 3D object at 24 evenly spaced rotation angles.
summary: Polar Slice Generation creates 24 binary volumetric slices for rotating displays using a single orthographic camera and boolean intersection, avoiding the complexity of multi-camera stereoscopy.
